note: Original content templates. A page generated from a template is a DRAFT and can be published only when editorial_gate() passes: enough reviewed tools with enough valid sources, any required hands-on test evidence, and approval by a named editor. Templates never invent testing, rankings, ratings or prices: every fact comes from a sourced profile and carries its source and date. Pages that cannot pass stay unpublished (or noindex) instead of becoming thin pages.

best-for-task.label: Tools for a specific task
best-for-task.intent: A person has a job to do and wants a shortlist with reasons
sections: Ranked shortlist with reasons for each match
Evidence level and last-verified date per tool
best-for-task.status: implemented as solutions.php (indexable only through the gate)

a-vs-b.label: Tool A versus Tool B
a-vs-b.intent: A person is choosing between two named tools
sections: Feature matrix with unknown values marked
never: declaring a winner on quality without tests

alternatives.label: Alternatives to a tool
alternatives.intent: A person wants options to a tool they know
sections: Why people look for alternatives (from documented limitations)
alternatives.status: implemented as alternatives.php (needs the tool plus three reviewed alternatives)
never: listing unreviewed tools as documented alternatives

pricing-comparison.label: Pricing and capability comparison for a group of tools
pricing-comparison.intent: A person wants prices and plan limits side by side with their sources and dates
sections: Pricing as stated, with as-of date and confidence
never: calculating prices the sources do not state

industry-workflow.label: AI workflow for a specific industry
industry-workflow.intent: A person in an industry wants a practical, realistic workflow
sections: The job and who does it
What we did and did not test
